steps.note: Start an eRFX project creation flow.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the required tenant configuration for vendor addition during creation.
Configure the draft with an offered template.
Add the required line item to make the draft valid enough to reopen.
Complete the pricing sheet for the draft.
Commit a schedule so the saved draft has its event schedule configured.
Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before selecting the Drafts tab.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the draft's publish flow without confirming publication.
Assert that the Publish Event window opens.
Assert that the window offers Edit Schedule.
Assert that the window offers Publish, while leaving it unpressed so the event remains unchanged.
